subject.title: feat(tools/write): add append mode for agent writes

question: Should ordinary agent file writes expose append as `append?: boolean` on `write`, or should this PR be revised to a different append API shape before merge?
rationale: The user reports and source path support adding an append primitive, but choosing the stable model-facing tool contract is a maintainer product/API decision.

options.title: Accept boolean append after repair
options.body: Fix the Code Mode import regression, then land the PR if maintainers accept the small backwards-compatible `append?: boolean` extension.

options.title: Revise to mode or dedicated tool
options.body: Ask the branch to replace the boolean with an explicit `mode` field or a separate append tool if maintainers want stricter operation separation.

options.title: Choose the narrower competing PR
options.body: Use https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102243 as the landing candidate if maintainers prefer the smaller surface and close this PR only after a viable replacement is selected.

recommendation.title: Accept boolean append after repair
recommendation.body: Fix the Code Mode import regression, then land the PR if maintainers accept the small backwards-compatible `append?: boolean` extension.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the clearest available routing owner for the agent tool/API and Code Mode runtime boundary decisions in the inspected history.
